Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-002 (Retail Marketing and Communication) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Marketing and customer solutions, consumer behaviour in retail banking, personal selling, McClelland's three needs theory, in-store promotions
  • The AIDAS approach, budget sourcing strategies, types of stores, steps in individual selling versus B2B selling

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-002/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions (10 marks each unless printed otherwise). Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
